payload.title: Bug: settleClaim's preClaimRevision CAS refuses fgos return after the claim holder's own…
payload.description: Bug: settleClaim's preClaimRevision CAS refuses fgos return after the claim holder's own legitimate fgos edit. tsk-40m's claim-revision CAS check (src/state/store.mjs settleClaim, src/state/runtime-coordination.mjs getItemDurableRevision) hashes the WHOLE durable work item and compares it against the value frozen in .fgos/runtime/claims/<id>.json at claim (pick/take) time. Any fgos edit call made by the SAME live claim holder between claim and return (e.g. fgos-coding-discovering step 5's own documented fgos edit --tier/--kind/--risk before fgos discover) changes that hash, and fgos return then unconditionally refuses with settleClaim: item durable revision changed from X to Y -- exit 3. The only built-in recovery (claim-port.mjs stale-claim-reclaim, isReclaimEligible) is gated on real inactivity, so it never fires for a still-live actively-committing session -- there is no CLI verb to refresh a live claim's own preClaimRevision. Hit live on tsk-28x 2026-08-25: pick claimed the item, a later fgos edit --tier heavy --risk heavy changed the durable hash, and fgos return then refused (exit 3, durable revision changed) even though the full implementation was already committed and npm test was green (3658 passing, Iron Law evidence written). Needs either: a CLI-exposed way for a live claim holder to refresh its own claim's preClaimRevision, or settleClaim excluding edit-only field drift (title/description/tier/kind/risk/verify/refs/priority) from the revision hash and only failing CAS on drift caused by a DIFFERENT writer.
